review:
SUMMARY: 12 confirmed bugs across core, crypto, db, and json modules involving missing bounds checks, race conditions, and incorrect index/substring logic. All reproduced and verified.

POINTS:
- [hutool-core/src/main/java/cn/hutool/core/io/FileMagicNumber.java:263-267] ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException in AAC.match() when bytes.length == 1 due to guard checking < 1 but accessing bytes[1] — fix: change guard to bytes.length < 2
- [hutool-crypto/src/main/java/cn/hutool/crypto/digest/BCrypt.java:421-439] StringIndexOutOfBoundsException for short salt strings in hashpw() instead of IllegalArgumentException due to missing length check before charAt/substring — fix: add if (salt.length() < 29) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid salt") before format validation
- [hutool-crypto/src/main/java/cn/hutool/crypto/symmetric/Vigenere.java:25] ArithmeticException (division by zero) in encrypt() when cipher key is empty due to dataLen / cipherKeyLen without zero check — fix: add Assert.notEmpty(cipherKey) or equivalent validation at method start
- [hutool-core/src/main/java/cn/hutool/core/io/FileMagicNumber.java:246-257] ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException in M4A.match() when bytes.length < 4 due to missing length guard on second OR branch accessing bytes[0..3] — fix: add bytes.length > 3 && before the second OR branch
- [hutool-core/src/main/java/cn/hutool/core/io/FileMagicNumber.java:275-297] ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException in AMR.match() when bytes.length == 11 due to guard checking < 11 but accessing bytes[11] — fix: change guard to bytes.length < 12
- [hutool-core/src/main/java/cn/hutool/core/text/csv/CsvRow.java:194] IndexOutOfBoundsException in get() for negative index instead of returning null as documented — fix: change condition to index < 0 || index >= fields.size() ? null : fields.get(index)
- [hutool-core/src/main/java/cn/hutool/core/text/AntPathMatcher.java:869] Incorrect wildcard counting: substring(pos - 1) returns rest of string instead of two characters, breaking singleWildcards logic — fix: change to this.pattern.substring(pos - 1, pos + 1).equals(".*")
- [hutool-core/src/main/java/cn/hutool/core/date/DateUtil.java:905-908] StringIndexOutOfBoundsException when parsing ISO8601 date with 1-char zone offset due to unchecked zoneOffset.substring(0, 2) — fix: add if (zoneOffset.length() < 2) throw new DateException(...) before substring
- [hutool-crypto/src/main/java/cn/hutool/crypto/digest/DigestUtil.java:199] StringIndexOutOfBoundsException in md5HexTo16() when input < 24 chars due to unchecked substring(8, 24) — fix: add if (md5Hex.length() < 24) throw new IllegalArgumentException(...) before substring
- [hutool-db/src/main/java/cn/hutool/db/ds/pooled/PooledDataSource.java:167-184] Thread-safety race condition: activeCount can exceed maxActive or go negative due to unsynchronized increments in getConnectionDirect() vs synchronized decrements in free() — fix: synchronize activeCount modifications or use AtomicInteger/ConcurrentLinkedQueue for thread-safe pool management
- [hutool-db/src/main/java/cn/hutool/db/sql/Condition.java:561-583] StringIndexOutOfBoundsException in unwrapQuote() for whitespace-only strings due to charAt(0) on empty trimmed string — fix: add if (value.isEmpty()) return value; after value.trim()
- [hutool-json/src/main/java/cn/hutool/json/JSONStrFormatter.java:122] Missing space after colon when colon is at index 0 due to condition i > 1 excluding i == 1 — fix: change condition to i > 0 at lines 55, 83, and 122

suspicions.observation: FileMagicNumber.AAC.match() checks 'bytes.length < 1' but then accesses bytes[0] and bytes[1]. If bytes.length == 1, it passes the guard but bytes[1] throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
suspicions.suspected_bug: ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException when AAC.match() is called with a byte array of length 1

suspicions.observation: DateUtil.parseISO8601() checks '!StrUtil.isBlank(zoneOffset)' but then calls 'zoneOffset.substring(0, 2)'. If zoneOffset is a single character like "+" (e.g. "2019-06-01T19:45:43+"), it passes the blank check but substring(0,2) throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
suspicions.suspected_bug: StringIndexOutOfBoundsException when parsing ISO8601 date with zone offset shorter than 2 chars (e.g., "2019-06-01T19:45:43+")

suspicions.observation: FileMagicNumber.MP3.match() checks 'bytes.length < 2' but flag1 accesses bytes[2]. When bytes.length == 2, the guard passes but bytes[2] causes ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
suspicions.suspected_bug: ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException when MP3.match() is called with a byte array of length 2

suspicions.observation: Two identical System.arraycopy calls at lines 131-134: 'System.arraycopy(tmpAlphabet, 0, tmpSeparators, tmpSeparators.length - missingSeparators, missingSeparators);' appears twice consecutively with the same parameters. This looks like a copy-paste error where the second call is redundant or was supposed to do something different.
suspicions.suspected_bug: Redundant double arraycopy call - the same System.arraycopy is executed twice with identical parameters, potentially a copy-paste error

suspicions.observation: BCrypt.hashpw() checks salt.charAt(0), salt.charAt(1), salt.charAt(2), and salt.charAt(3) for format validation, but does not check the total length of the salt before calling salt.charAt(off + 2) or salt.substring(off + 3, off + 25). If salt is short (e.g., "$2$"), these calls would throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException instead of a meaningful error message.
suspicions.suspected_bug: StringIndexOutOfBoundsException for short salt strings in BCrypt.hashpw() instead of proper IllegalArgumentException

suspicions.observation: Vigenere.encrypt() computes 'dataLen / cipherKeyLen' at line 25 without checking if cipherKeyLen is 0. If cipherKey is empty (length 0), this causes ArithmeticException (/ by zero). Similarly, decrypt() uses cipherKeyLen in the loop but the inner loop would simply not execute, though no validation is present either.
suspicions.suspected_bug: ArithmeticException (division by zero) when Vigenere.encrypt() is called with an empty cipher key

suspicions.observation: In IdcardUtil.isValidHKCard(), after the regex match and parentheses removal, card can be as short as 7 chars (e.g., 'A123456'). In the else branch, card.substring(7, 8) is called, which throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException when card.length() is 7 since index 8 is out of bounds. The method does handle the length==9 case specially but not length==7 or 8 uniformly.
suspicions.suspected_bug: StringIndexOutOfBoundsException in isValidHKCard() when validating a valid 7-char HK card like 'A123456' due to substring(7, 8) on a 7-char string

suspicions.observation: In M4A.match(), the expression is '(bytes.length > 10 && ...) || (Objects.equals(bytes[0]...))'. The second OR branch accesses bytes[0], bytes[1], bytes[2], bytes[3] without any length guard. When bytes.length < 4, short-circuit in the first branch fails (length <= 10), then the second branch evaluates and throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
suspicions.suspected_bug: ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException in M4A.match() when bytes.length < 4 due to missing length guard on the second OR branch

suspicions.observation: In AMR.match(), the guard checks 'bytes.length < 11' but flag2 accesses bytes[11] (line 296). When bytes.length == 11, the guard passes (length is not < 11) but bytes[11] is out of bounds, causing ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. The guard should be '< 12' since the max index accessed is 11.
suspicions.suspected_bug: ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException in AMR.match() when bytes.length == 11 due to accessing bytes[11] without sufficient length guard

suspicions.observation: CsvRow.get(int index) only checks 'index >= fields.size()' but not 'index < 0'. When a negative index is passed, the check passes (false), and fields.get(index) throws IndexOutOfBoundsException instead of returning null like it does for out-of-bounds positive indices.
suspicions.suspected_bug: IndexOutOfBoundsException in CsvRow.get() for negative index instead of returning null as documented behavior for out-of-bounds

suspicions.observation: DigestUtil.md5HexTo16() calls md5Hex.substring(8, 24) without checking if md5Hex has at least 24 characters. If a shorter string is passed (e.g., 16 chars or less), StringIndexOutOfBoundsException is thrown instead of a meaningful error message.
suspicions.suspected_bug: StringIndexOutOfBoundsException in md5HexTo16() when input string is shorter than 24 characters

suspicions.observation: Line 869: this.pattern.substring(pos - 1).equals(".*") - substring(pos-1) returns the entire string from pos-1 to END, not just two characters. It should be this.pattern.substring(pos - 1, pos + 1).equals(".*") to correctly check if the last two characters form ".*". This causes singleWildcards to be incorrectly counted because the comparison is almost always false when the pattern is longer than 2 chars.
suspicions.suspected_bug: Wrong substring range in pattern wildcard counting: substring(pos - 1) without end index returns rest of string instead of just two characters, causing incorrect singleWildcards count

suspicions.observation: PooledDataSource.getConnectionDirect() (line 167) is NOT synchronized but modifies activeCount (line 182) and checks maxActive (line 173). Meanwhile free() (line 112) IS synchronized and decrements activeCount (line 113). The getConnection(long wait) method (line 138) is also NOT synchronized. This means concurrent calls can increment activeCount past maxActive limit, and activeCount can become negative if free() races with getConnectionDirect().
suspicions.suspected_bug: Thread-safety race condition in PooledDataSource: activeCount can exceed maxActive or become negative due to unsynchronized increments in getConnectionDirect() vs synchronized decrements in free()

suspicions.observation: Condition.unwrapQuote(String value) at lines 569-570 does value.trim() and then immediately calls value.charAt(0) and value.charAt(value.length() - 1) without checking if the trimmed value is empty. If value is a string of only whitespace (e.g., "   "), after trim() it becomes "" with length 0, and charAt(0) will throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
suspicions.suspected_bug: Condition.unwrapQuote throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException when given a string consisting entirely of whitespace, because charAt(0) is called on the empty trimmed string

suspicions.observation: JSONStrFormatter.format() at line 122 has condition `if ((i > 1) && (json.charAt(i - 1) == CharUtil.COLON))` which only adds space after colon when i > 1. When the JSON string starts with a colon at position 0 followed by a value character at position 1 (i=1), the space won't be added because i > 1 is false. The same issue exists at lines 55 and 83.
suspicions.suspected_bug: JSONStrFormatter.format() fails to add space after a colon when the colon is at index 0 (first position), because the condition i > 1 excludes i == 1 where the character after colon would be processed

bugs.observation: FileMagicNumber.AAC.match() checks 'bytes.length < 1' but then accesses bytes[0] and bytes[1]. If bytes.length == 1, it passes the guard but bytes[1] throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
bugs.suspected_bug: ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException when AAC.match() is called with a byte array of length 1
bugs.evidence: FileMagicNumber.java:266 — AAC.match() guards bytes.length < 1 but accesses bytes[1], causing ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException on single-byte arrays.
bugs.reproduction:
mvn test -Dtest=cn.hutool.core.io.FileMagicNumberAacMatchTest -pl hutool-core -am -q

Exit=1. Output:
[ERROR] Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 1, Skipped: 0
[ERROR] cn.hutool.core.io.FileMagicNumberAacMatchTest.matchWithSingleByteShouldReturnFalseNotThrow -- Time elapsed: 0.004 s <<< ERROR!
java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 1 out of bounds for length 1
	at cn.hutool.core.io.FileMagicNumber$20.match(FileMagicNumber.java:266)
	at cn.hutool.core.io.FileMagicNumberAacMatchTest.matchWithSingleByteShouldReturnFalseNotThrow(FileMagicNumberAacMatchTest.java:22)

Same error on /src/old — bug is pre-existing in both trees.

<?xml version='1.0' encoding='utf-8'?>

	<version>5.8.46</version>
	<name>hutool</name>
	<description>Hutool是一个小而全的Java工具类库，通过静态方法封装，降低相关API的学习成本，提高工作效率，使Java拥有函数式语言般的优雅，让Java语言也可以“甜甜的”。</description>

		<module>hutool-cache</module>
		<module>hutool-core</module>
		<module>hutool-cron</module>
		<module>hutool-crypto</module>
		<module>hutool-db</module>
		<module>hutool-dfa</module>

		<module>hutool-log</module>
		<module>hutool-script</module>
		<module>hutool-setting</module>
		<module>hutool-system</module>

			<artifactId>jaxb-api</artifactId>
			<version>2.3.1</version>
		</dependency>

bugs.observation: Line 869: this.pattern.substring(pos - 1).equals(".*") - substring(pos-1) returns the entire string from pos-1 to END, not just two characters. It should be this.pattern.substring(pos - 1, pos + 1).equals(".*") to correctly check if the last two characters form ".*". This causes singleWildcards to be incorrectly counted because the comparison is almost always false when the pattern is longer than 2 chars.

bugs.observation: PooledDataSource.getConnectionDirect() (line 167) is NOT synchronized but modifies activeCount (line 182) and checks maxActive (line 173). Meanwhile free() (line 112) IS synchronized and decrements activeCount (line 113). The getConnection(long wait) method (line 138) is also NOT synchronized. This means concurrent calls can increment activeCount past maxActive limit, and activeCount can become negative if free() races with getConnectionDirect().
bugs.suspected_bug: Thread-safety race condition in PooledDataSource: activeCount can exceed maxActive or become negative due to unsynchronized increments in getConnectionDirect() vs synchronized decrements in free()
bugs.evidence: PooledDataSource.java:167-184: getConnectionDirect() is unsynchronized but checks maxActive against activeCount (line 173) then increments activeCount (line 182); under concurrent access 50 threads all passed the check and got connections when maxActive=5
